title: SLAP ALL src
features: To get started, you'll need a slap tool. The easiest way to get one is to use noclip to enter one of the transparent boxes, pick up the slap, and you're all set. Have fun!
script:
local P = game:GetService("Players")
local lp = P.LocalPlayer
_G.running = true

while _G.running do
	local char = lp.Character
	local glove = char and (char:FindFirstChild("DarkBlueGlove") or char:FindFirstChild("RainbowGlove"))
	if glove then
		for _, v in P:GetPlayers() do
			if v ~= lp and v.Character and v.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
				glove.Event:FireServer("slash", v.Character, vector.create(math.huge, math.huge, -math.huge))
			end
		end
	end
	task.wait(.1)
end
